     title is always numbered, which would make this page Chapter 1 and
     shift every cross-reference by one (Chapter 4's figures came out as
     "Figure 5.1"). An unnumbered H1 with no front matter is how Quarto's
     own book template does it. -->

# Welcome {.unnumbered}

An open access Personality Psychology textbook by
[Patrick Durkee](https://www.pdurkee.com), Assistant Professor of Psychology at
California State University, Fresno.

The book is free to read online, and licensed so that other instructors and
students may reuse and adapt it. It is written for an undergraduate
personality psychology course and assumes no prior background.

::: {.start-reading}
[Start reading →](01-foundational-frameworks.qmd){.btn-start}
:::

## Chapters

| | Chapter | What it covers |
|--:|:--|:--|
| 1 | [Foundational Frameworks](01-foundational-frameworks.qmd) | Levels of analysis, Tinbergen's four questions, Marr's three levels |
| 2 | [Past Perspectives](02-past-perspectives.qmd) | Psychodynamic, neo-Freudian, humanistic and behaviorist approaches |
| 3 | [Contemporary Perspectives](03-contemporary-perspectives.qmd) | Trait, social-cognitive, biological and evolutionary approaches |
| 4 | [Measurement Matters](04-measurement-matters.qmd) | Reliability, validity, and measuring personality well |
| 5 | [Personality Power](05-personality-power.qmd) | How much personality predicts, and how that compares with situations |
| 6 | [Evolution and Personality](06-evolution-and-personality.qmd) | Adaptations, adaptive problems, psychological mechanisms |
| 7 | [Genetics and Personality](07-genetics-and-personality.qmd) | Twin studies, heritability, shared and non-shared environments |
| 8 | [Physiology and Personality](08-physiology-and-personality.qmd) | Neurotransmitters, hormones, and physiological variation |
| 9 | [Emotions and Personality](09-emotions-and-personality.qmd) | Emotions as evolved mechanisms and their links to traits |
| 10 | [Motivation and Personality](10-motivation-and-personality.qmd) | Internal regulatory variables and fundamental motives |
| 11 | [Development and Personality](11-development-and-personality.qmd) | Rank-order stability, mean-level change, maturation |
| 12 | [Culture and Personality](12-culture-and-personality.qmd) | Cross-cultural structure, cultural dimensions, WEIRD samples |
| 13 | [Personality Change](13-personality-change.qmd) | Volitional change, interventions, and what change requires |

## About this edition

This edition was converted from the chapter summaries written for Dr. Durkee's
Personality Psychology course. All thirteen chapters are available. The page
footer shows when the book was last updated.

Corrections and suggestions are welcome by
[email](mailto:pdurkee@csufresno.edu).
